
DESCRIPTION
Build projects

USAGE
  one build [projects...] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one build
  one build web
  one build apps/web --dry-run
  one build web --env prod

TIPS
Build all buildable projects, or selected project names or paths. Node runs its build script; Go runs task build. Respect local dependencies among selected projects, with concurrency 1 by default. Tools and dependencies are prepared first. One task keeps its native terminal; multiple tasks use the TUI.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --concurrency <value>    Maximum concurrent builds, respecting dependencies
  --dry-run                Show the build plan without installing tools, loading secrets, or running commands
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --ui <value>             Terminal interface: auto | raw | tui | stream

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  --env <value>            Environment to load for each project
  -p, --project <value>    Project name or relative path; defaults to all buildable projects
